title: Tooling: 1.45-1.50x faster exact CK dyadic replay (no new kappa)
body:
Tooling improvement: accelerate the exact integer-dyadic primitive replay in Ross Richardson's incorporated PR917 while retaining its complete verifier and mathematical coverage. ADD deletes cancelled coefficients during insertion; normalization stops when an odd numerator proves the common two-adic valuation is zero. Only two kernels are replaced in memory, through an opt-in adapter.

Five alternating paired runs on identical four-stream inputs measured **1.45x** on Python 3.12.13 (0.90050 s -> 0.62027 s) and **1.50x** on Python 3.14.5 (1.03788 s -> 0.68973 s). These are integer-stage timings, excluding construction, Fraction replay and native audit; no whole-verifier or multiplication-runtime speedup is claimed. Both reports include every sample and identical complete input/result hashes.

Validation compares all 226,210 replaced-kernel returns and every result field across 374,606 primitives and all 725 arbitrary input columns. The complete unchanged PR917 verifier still executes its construction census, separate Fraction engine, native frame/wrapper audit and all 10+25 original negative controls. Additional coverage includes 328,050 signed sums, 729 normalizations, a 3,000-step Fraction oracle, COPY/dirt/transient/domain tests, adapter restoration and rejection of drift in all fourteen live inputs. The deterministic full predecessor receipt is unchanged.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/ck-dyadic-replay-fast/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_CK_DYADIC_REPLAY_FAST streams=4 primitives=374606 columns=725 controls=10+25 no_new_kappa`.

Python 3.12 registered replay and Python 3.14 normal/optimized full verification pass. The package supplies a registered replay, exact Git-blob/SHA256 source inventory, kernel argument, deterministic receipt and separate benchmarks. Only `research/ck-dyadic-replay-fast/` is added.

Exact base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; OS assignment seed **89**, verification engineering. Predecessor PR917 reviewed head: `085c32a25e2a09b029fa816195b97fa93d6f0788`; PR626/622 and other exact pins are in SOURCES.json. Main was refreshed to `410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983`; consumed paths are unchanged. Final complete overlap coverage: 787 open PRs and 146 Discussion/comment/reply records. PR1234 targets frame geometry; PR1184 targets mutable macro-auditor rows; this targets PR917's immutable canonical primitive rows, including transient denominator and dirty scratch reporting. Their performance figures are not combined.

No pinned coordination issue exists, so the claim is local. No selected-frontier change, new kappa, supplier adoption, full multiplication proof or hosted-CI pass is asserted. Inherited compiler/realization/hosting/precision/tape/analytic obligations remain.

Credit Ross Richardson/PR917, David Awad/PR807, @dd-hemant/PR816, PR749/759, and the retained icekylinx/DreamingOfClouds/Jeremy Kothe/Chafik Boukhalfa lineage. Prior exact-dyadic adapter work retains its credit. Prepared for Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; parent-only execution, no independent human review. Apache-2.0. Open next questions and limits are in the README/TASK.
